To find the overdue rentals for Maria Miller, we need to join the rental table with the inventory table on the inventory_id column. We also need to filter the results to only include rentals where the return date is null (i.e., overdue). Finally, we can select the title of the film from the film table.

To recommend two Sci-Fi movies, we can join the film_category table with the category table on the category_id column and then join this result with the film table on the film_id column. We can filter the results to only include films where the name is 'Sci-Fi' and select the title of the film.

Here's how you can do it:

```sql
SELECT f.title 
FROM film f JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id 
JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id 
WHERE r.customer_id = 100 AND r.return_date IS NULL

UNION

SELECT fc.film_id 
FROM film_category fc JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id 
WHERE c.name = 'Sci-Fi' LIMIT 2;
```
